consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1993-06-13 show at Rich Stadium was a solid performance, with standout moments in several songs. While some reviewers noted a few missteps and the presence of new songs, the overall vibe was enjoyable, and many appreciated the energy of the band.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 27 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and highlighted specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the overall impact of the show and some vocal sloppiness.
